approaches.title: Right-to-left binary addition
approaches.summary: Adds the binary strings from right to left while propagating a carry, stores result digits in reverse order, then reverses the output. Revision 2 refines the same strategy with byte iterators and arithmetic instead of branching.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements right-to-left binary addition using reversed byte iterators, explicit digit matching, and carry propagation.
Keeps the same addition strategy while using peekable byte iterators and modulo/division arithmetic to reduce branching and improve idiomaticity.
